qual.p: Floors and bathrooms by Porcelanosa Grupo, JUNG switches and Guardian glass. The finishes are defined in the project; you can see them at the Porcelanosa showroom on a visit arranged by JD León.
q1.s: Porcelanosa Grupo vinyl flooring in 22.8 × 180 cm planks.
q2.s: Thermostatic shower column and wall-hung vanity unit.
q3.s: In alpine white. A classic of German design.
q4.s: Insulation against cold and heat, with aluminium roller shutters.
q6.s: Fully integrated, with no visible units.
q7.s: Interior doors lacquered in white, with concealed hinges.
q8.s: Pre-installation of fibre optic cabling and data points in the home.
loc.h2: Between the city and the mountains.
loc.p: On Carretera de Santa Catalina, at the corner of Calle Los Mateos, south of Murcia: 3 minutes by car from El Carmen station and 6 from the city centre, with the Ronda Sur ring road and the motorways next door. Opposite, Central Training Santa Catalina, a large newly opened martial-arts, cross-training and weights centre; to the south, Santo Ángel and the El Valle hills.
loc.svg: Distances from Edificio Biera: 1.6 km to Hospital Mesa del Castillo, 3.5 km to Estación del Carmen and 4.8 km to Hospital Virgen de la Arrixaca
con.p: Daniel León walks you through each home, answers your questions and arranges your visit to the site and to the Porcelanosa showroom.

faq.a1: Every home has a third floor under the roof with an extra room of 7.85 to 16.30 m² usable area, depending on the home, next to the private roof terrace. It can be an office, a study, a guest bedroom or a playroom.
faq.a2: Yes. Six homes (1 to 5 and 8) have a private closed garage in the basement with its own staircase; the other four come with a parking space. The homes table shows which one belongs to each.
faq.a3: No. The kitchen is delivered unfitted, so each owner can choose the design and appliances they prefer. Floor and bathroom finishes are defined in the project and can be seen at the Porcelanosa showroom.
faq.a4: Each home is sold as a whole: its three floors, the private roof terrace and the closed garage or parking space that belongs to it. Prices are quoted before VAT; the applicable VAT (10%) is not included.
faq.q5: When will the homes be delivered?
faq.a5: Handover is scheduled from February 2027. JD León will confirm in writing the date and conditions that apply to the home you are interested in.
faq.q6: How can I visit or reserve?
faq.a6: By appointment through JD León Inmobiliaria (+34 640 51 24 34 · info@jdleon.com): they will show you the building and its surroundings and walk you through the plans, finishes and availability. If you decide to go ahead, you will receive the reservation process and timings in writing.
